Label: Augmented Ability
Hover text: Lets the user pick one of their own existing abilities, usually a strike, and make it as part of this ability with a change applied. The picked ability uses this ability's action and cost. Used by the Gnoll Cackler's "target makes a free strike".
New editor's description: Turn this ability into a modifier for another.
Notes: Prose template exists; Must be the only block on its ability.

Label: Custom Trigger
Hover text: Sends a named signal, with an optional number, to each target. Any triggered ability on that creature listening for the same name can respond. Used by the gnolls' Cackletongue.
New editor's description: Fire a custom event trigger.
Notes: The name must match the listening trigger exactly. By default the ability carries on without waiting. Tick "Wait for trigger to resolve" to pause until the trigger is used or declined.

Label: Recast Ability
Hover text: Lets the user pick an ability that any creature used since the round began (limited by a filter) and use a copy of it. Used by the Troubadour's Encore and the Reaver's Death Strike.
New editor's description: Recast another ability as part of this one.
Notes: Prose template exists; Turns the ability into a picker when used. Only abilities recorded in this round's chat log are offered.

Label: Steal Ability
Hover text: Shows the target's abilities, lets the user pick one, and gives the user a copy for the length of an attached effect. An option can use the target's characteristic bonuses in the copy. Used by the Troubadour's College of the Harlequin Mask and the Absorption treasure.
New editor's description: Copy or steal an ability from a target.
Notes: Prose template exists; Needs an effect set up, or nothing happens.

Label: Build Wall
Hover text: Builds a solid wall one square at a time on the targeted squares. The wall appears while the player picks the squares, and an option can remove the user's previous wall. Used by the Elementalist's Motivate Earth and the stone giant's Castle Stone Shape.
Notes: Needs a map object with the "wallvoxel" keyword chosen as the wall piece. Without one it does nothing.

Label: Create Item
Hover text: Gives each target a chosen item. The quantity is rolled first and can be a fixed number or dice such as 2d6.
New editor's description: Create an item and add it to inventory.
Notes: Uses the old pop-up roll dialog, not the newer sidebar roll card.

Label: Create Object
Hover text: Places map objects from the object library in the target area, such as walls, brambles or spikes. It puts one on each square or one big object over the whole area, and can first push creatures standing there out of the way. Used by the Thorn Dragon's Bramble Barricade.
New editor's description: Summon an object or terrain feature on the map.
Notes: Prose template exists

Label: Discard Items
Hover text: Makes each target drop or destroy items from its equipped gear or whole inventory: all of them, or one or several the player chooses. Dropped items appear on the map as loot.
New editor's description: Force targets to discard items.
Notes: Looks unfinished. The default "Items in Hand" choice has been removed and does nothing, so pick another. "Named Items" isn't implemented. Leaves debug output in the log.

Label: Portal Transit
Hover text: When a creature steps onto a portal, it can teleport to an empty square next to any other portal of the same name placed by the same creature. Declining leaves it where it is. Used by the Void Elementalist's There Is No Space Between.
Notes: Only works when triggered by a portal aura's "on enter".

Label: Raise Corpse
Hover text: Brings a dead creature back onto the map at its corpse, optionally at full Stamina with its conditions cleared. Used by undead "rises again" traits such as the Zombie's Endless Knight.
New editor's description: Raise a defeated creature as an ally.
Notes: Prose template exists; Must target a corpse object. Brings back full Stamina; to bring it back at a lower amount, add a Set Stamina block.

Label: Relocate Aura
Hover text: Moves one of the user's placed auras, found by name, to the targeted spot. Used by the Elementalist's Storm of Sands.
Notes: The aura name must match exactly, and the ability must target a spot or area.

Label: Summon Companion
Hover text: Lets the player pick any Animal Companion creature from the bestiary and places it at the target square (or beside the user) as the user's companion, acting on the user's turn.
New editor's description: Summon a companion creature.
Notes: Looks like an older version: the Beastheart's Call Companion button uses a different system. This block spawns a new companion each time and doesn't remove the old one. Has no settings.

Label: Summon Creatures
Hover text: Brings new creatures onto the map, either a set monster or a choice from a filtered bestiary list. Options cover how many appear, where they are placed, who controls them, their initiative and whether they stay after combat. Used by the Troll Whelp's Lingering Hunger.
New editor's description: Summon creatures onto the battlefield.
Notes: The default bestiary filter is a leftover from another game ("cr = 1 and type is beast"). Replace it. Can also replace the caster (Gnoll Carnage's transform).

Label: Terraform Elevation
Hover text: Raises or lowers the ground in the target area by a set height, for pits and pillars. Can optionally move creatures to the new height and check whether anyone falls. Used by the Orc Terranova and the Fossil Cryptic's stone pillars.
New editor's description: Change the elevation of map squares.
Notes: Prose template exists

Label: Terraform Terrain
Hover text: Paints a ground texture over the target area, such as churned earth. Often paired with Terraform Elevation, as on the Orc Terranova.
New editor's description: Change the terrain type of map squares.
Notes: Prose template exists; Looks visual only. It does not seem to create difficult terrain (abilities use an aura for that). Not fully confirmed.

Label: Transform Creatures
Hover text: Turns each target into a monster form for the length of an attached effect, chosen by the player or at random from monsters that match a filter. Used by the Animal Form complication, the Rat Form treasure and Disciple of the Green.
New editor's description: Transform creatures into a different form.
Notes: Needs an effect set up, or nothing happens. The default monster filter uses old level/"beast" terms, so replace it.

Label: Transform Zone
Hover text: Turns a painted map zone of one type into another type, or removes it, for example lighting Flammable Oil into burning oil with a torch. It can look at the targets' squares, the squares next to them, or the whole area. If no zone is found, the rest of the ability stops.

Label: Character Speech
Hover text: Shows a speech bubble from each target with a random line from a list you write, not repeating until all lines are used. Used by the Troubadour and by effects like Choking.
New editor's description: Display character speech or narration.
Notes: Prose template exists; If the creature currently speaks no language, it shows a fallback line ("..." by default).

Label: Disguise
Hover text: Changes how a token looks: the caster takes on a target's appearance, or the targets take the look of a monster picked from the bestiary. Used by the Stormwight Fury's animal forms and the War Dog Lesser Hypokrite.
New editor's description: Change the visual appearance of a token.
Notes: Prose template exists; Changes the look only (plus footprints and blood). Stats stay the same.

Label: Dramatic Banner
Hover text: Shows a full-screen banner (heroic or malice style) with a title and subtitle on a creature, and pauses the ability until it finishes. Used by the Shadow's "Hesitation is Weakness" ("{name} steps in and takes their turn").

Label: Open Character Sheet
Hover text: Opens the user's character sheet on a chosen tab, such as the Builder. Used by monster templates like "Choose an Ancestry" so the Director can make the template's choices.
New editor's description: Open the caster's character sheet on a chosen tab (e.g. Builder).
Notes: Menu shortcut, not a game effect.

Label: Play Sound
Hover text: Plays a built-in sound effect or a custom audio file, with optional volume and delay. Used by the Stormwight animal forms.
New editor's description: Play a sound effect.
Notes: Prose template exists; Not sure custom sounds are heard by everyone. They may play only on the user's own machine.

Label: Show Journal Entry
Hover text: Opens a journal document for the player, adding any explanation text from the user's features under extra headings.
New editor's description: Display a journal entry to the player.
Notes: Opens only on the screen of the player using the ability. The "Apply To" setting has no effect. Shows nothing if the document and the extra text are both empty.

Label: Confer Conditions
Hover text: Copies conditions from a source creature (the user by default) onto the targets, keeping their duration and who caused them: all of them, or ones the player picks. The source keeps its conditions.
Notes: Copies conditions only, not other ongoing effects. Not used by any content yet.

Label: Limit Active Effects
Hover text: Caps how many creatures can carry one of the user's ongoing effects, removing it from the oldest ones to make room for the new targets. Place it before the block that applies the effect. Used by the Shadow's "Careful Observation" (one observed creature, rising with level).

Label: Save Ends To End Of Turn
Hover text: Lets the player pick a "save ends" condition or effect on each target and change it to end at the end of the turn instead. Used by the High Elves' Otherworldly Grace.
Engine name: Save Ends To End Of Turn
Notes: Can be set to allow picking several effects at once.

Label: Set Source of Condition
Hover text: Changes who a condition is tied to, so a creature becomes frightened of or taunted by the target instead of the original user. It works on conditions this ability just inflicted or on the user's own conditions; used by the Conduit's "Select Source of Fear" and the Shadow's Misdirecting Strike.
New editor's description: Set the source creature for a condition.
Notes: Only conditions that track their source (frightened, taunted, grabbed and similar) can be picked.

Label: Chain To Nearby Enemies
Hover text: Spreads the ability from its first target to every enemy within a set number of squares, then from each of those, until nobody new is in reach. The power roll after it hits every creature the chain reached. Used by the Shadow's "Chain Reaction".
Notes: Walls and creatures that block line of effect stop a jump.

Label: Destroy
Hover text: Kills the targets outright, whatever their Stamina, without setting off damage triggers. Used when a war dog's loyalty collar goes off.
New editor's description: Destroy a creature or object.
Notes: Prose template exists

Label: Remove Creature
Hover text: Takes the targets off the map without dealing damage, optionally leaving a corpse and dropping their treasure. By default it waits for other abilities, and optionally triggers, to finish first. Used by the war dogs' Loyalty Collar.
New editor's description: Remove a creature from the battlefield.
Notes: Prose template exists; Heroes are hidden rather than deleted. If a removed creature was taking its turn, the turn ends.

Label: Set Stamina
Hover text: Sets each target's Stamina to an exact value instead of healing or damaging them. Used by the Wraith's Stolen Vitality and the elementals' Elemental Swap.
New editor's description: Set a target's stamina to a specific value.
Notes: Prose template exists

Label: Forced Movement Origin
Hover text: Picks the point that later push and pull blocks measure from: the centre of an aura or area, a creature the user chooses, or the first target. Used by Gravitic Well's "pull toward the center of the area".
New editor's description: Push, pull, or slide targets from a chosen origin.
Notes: Prose template exists; Moves nothing itself. Put it before the push/pull.

Label: Taunt By Nearest
Hover text: Makes each target taunted by whichever creature or attackable object is nearest to it, and can apply an extra effect on chosen tiers. Used by the Wyvern malice feature "Overflowing Rage".
Notes: "Nearest" can be anyone, including the target's own allies.

Label: Creature List
Hover text: Adds a creature to a named list kept on the target, which empties on a chosen schedule (each turn, encounter and so on), so you can count different creatures. Used by the Troubadour's Drama trigger "three or more heroes use an ability on the same turn".
New editor's description: Build a list of creatures for later use.
Notes: Only useful when other blocks or formulas read the list size.

Label: Delay
Hover text: Pauses the ability for a number of seconds (60 at most) before the next block. It can also wait until a condition becomes true. Mostly used to time effects and deaths, e.g. during the Gnoll Carnage's transformation.
New editor's description: Pause execution for a duration.
Notes: Waiting on a condition gives up after 120 seconds and carries on anyway.

Label: Fizzle
Hover text: Takes the targets that pass its filter out of the rest of the ability, so later blocks skip them. If it applies to every target, it removes them all. Used by the Censor's Behold the Face of Justice! to drop targets who resist the potency.
New editor's description: Cancel or fizzle the current ability.

Label: Limit Ability Uses
Hover text: Lets the rest of this ability work only once per chosen period (encounter, round, turn, etc.). Later uses in that period stop at this block. Used by the Fury and several subclass "once per encounter" features.
New editor's description: Limit how many times this ability can be used.
Notes: The ability can still be started again; only the blocks after this one are skipped. Give two abilities the same Unique ID to share one limit.

Label: Manipulate Target Locations
Hover text: Moves the ability's targeted squares one floor down or up. Targets with no floor in that direction are dropped.
New editor's description: Manipulate remembered target locations.
Notes: Prose template exists; Not used by any content yet. Affects only targeted squares, not creatures.

Label: Manipulate Targets
Hover text: Asks the user to choose more targets, using this block's own targeting settings centred on each current target. The new targets are added to the list or replace it, and later blocks then affect them.
New editor's description: Prompt the caster to add or replace the ability's targets.
Notes: Prose template exists

Label: Modify Cast
Hover text: Adds a bonus to this use of the ability: extra damage, edges, banes, surges, or ignoring damage immunity. Used by the Tactician and the Summoner.
New editor's description: Add a damage bonus, edge, bane, surge, or ignore damage immunity.
Notes: Prose template exists; Probably needs to come before the power roll it should affect (not confirmed). It adds the bonus once per target in its list, so it can stack if it has several targets.

Label: Order Targets
Hover text: Sorts the targets by a formula, lowest first, so later blocks handle them in that order (for example, closest first). Used by the Fury's Thunder Roar and the water wolf.
New editor's description: Reorder the target list.
Notes: Only matters when order is important to later blocks.

Label: Remember Target
Hover text: Remembers the ability's first target so a trigger that fires later in the same use can check who it was (through "Stashed Target"). Used by the Shadow's "You Were Watching the Wrong One".
Notes: Remembers only one creature per user; the next use overwrites it.

Label: Reset Roll Status
Hover text: Clears the record of which targets were hit, failed a save, or won an opposed roll, so later blocks using those target lists start fresh. Useful when one ability makes several separate rolls.
New editor's description: Reset the roll status of the ability.
Notes: Developer-oriented. It only matters with the older "hit targets" / "failed save" target options.

Label: Track Stat
Hover text: Adds an amount (1 by default) to a named per-encounter statistic for a hero, for the end-of-encounter hero stats. Used by the Critical Hit rule to count each hero's criticals.
Notes: Only records for heroes in a live encounter. Monsters and out-of-combat uses are ignored without any message.

Label: Assign Movement Carrier
Hover text: Marks a creature within grab range as a passenger that moves along with the user, like a grabbed creature, by applying a chosen ongoing effect. Using it again on the same passenger lets them go.
Notes: The chosen effect must track one caster and must carry a Movement Carrier modifier, or nothing happens. Obeys the maximum grabbed creatures limit. Not used in any content yet.

Label: Change Movement Type
Hover text: Switches each target's current way of moving (walk, fly, swim, burrow and so on). Used by Wings' Fly and the Crux of Fire.
New editor's description: Change how a creature moves (fly, burrow, etc.).
Notes: Does not give a new way of moving. It only switches between ones the creature can already use.

Label: Climb Creature
Hover text: Lets the user climb onto each target, or makes targets get off whatever they are climbing, either sliding down safely or falling (with fall damage and prone). Used by the Climb Creature maneuver, Hold On and Fall Off Creature.

Label: Dig Vertical Movement
Hover text: The user picks how far to move straight up or down through the ground, up to its size by default, using +/- buttons. Used by the Dig maneuver.
Notes: It waits for any reactions to digging to finish before the choice appears.

Label: Displace Creatures Overlapping Caster
Hover text: Can first grow the user with a chosen size effect. It then moves every creature caught inside the user's space to the nearest free square (the user picks when several are equally near), and those creatures become the targets.
Notes: Not used by any content yet; it looks built for one specific engulf/grow monster ability.

Label: Fall
Hover text: Makes the targets fall if nothing is holding them up, using the normal falling rules. It can optionally stop a flying target from flying first ("Drop to Ground"). Used when Levitating ends.
New editor's description: Cause targets to fall.
Notes: Prose template exists

Label: Hop In Place
Hover text: Makes each target jump up and land back on its own square, with an optional screen shake. It does not move the creature. Used by the ogre's Shockwave.
Notes: Visual only.

Label: Hurl Grabbed Creature
Hover text: Throws a creature the user is grabbing to the far end of a line ability. The grab ends, the creature lands on the last square of the line (or the nearest free square to it), and it is added to the targets so the power roll that follows hits it too. Used by the Ogre Goon's "People Bowling".
Notes: Not forced movement: stability, collisions and push distance don't apply. Needs a line-shaped ability and must come before the power roll.

Label: Jump (Roll to Target)
Hover text: The player picks where to land, with rings showing how far each roll result reaches. A roll is made only when the jump goes farther or higher than normal, and a poor roll lands the creature short, which can make it fall. Used by the Jump move action and the Null's Psionic Leap.

Label: Lift Into The Air
Hover text: Lifts each target straight up a set number of squares. When the ability ends, a target that can no longer fly is put back on the ground or falls. Used by the Levitated effect and the ghost.
Notes: The target must already be able to fly. Grant flight earlier in the same ability.

Label: Pull Into Caster Space
Hover text: Moves each target straight into the user's own space for free (it counts as forced movement and passes through creatures), with an optional floating label such as "Pulled in!".
Notes: Not used by any content yet. Probably meant to be paired with Displace Creatures Overlapping Caster.

Label: Revert Location
Hover text: Stops a creature that is moving past the caster at the first square of its path within a set distance, "catching" it there. Used by the Bugbears' Catcher.
New editor's description: Return targets to their previous locations.
Notes: Prose template exists; Only works in a triggered ability set off by movement. Elsewhere there is no path to read and nothing happens.

Label: Teleport To Line End
Hover text: Teleports the user to the far end of a line ability, or the free square closest to it, after everyone in the line has been hit. Used by the Shadow's "Shadowfall".
Notes: Needs a line-shaped ability. Shows "No room to reappear" if every square in the line is occupied.

Label: Throw Object
Hover text: Throws the map object that gives this ability to the targeted square. The object counts as force-moved, so effects like "takes damage per square moved" apply. Used by the Candelabra.
Notes: Only for abilities a map object gives to creatures (or uses itself). Give the ability a square target and a range.

Label: Modify Power Roll
Hover text: Adds a modifier to this ability's own power roll, such as an edge, extra damage or a rider. Whoever rolls can take it as an option in the roll dialog. Used by options like "Blood for Blood!".
New editor's description: Add a bonus or penalty to a power roll.
Notes: Prose template exists; Does nothing alone. It needs a Power Roll block in the same ability.

Label: Manifest Treasure
Hover text: Equips a treasure the hero picked earlier, or removes it again ("vanish"). Used by the Artifact Bonded complication, where the artifact appears and disappears.
Notes: Only works together with a Grant Treasure feature set to manifest mode that has the same treasure id.

Label: Pay Ability Cost
Hover text: Spends the ability's cost at this exact point instead of when its effects first land, so later steps can't skip or refund it. Used by the Troubadour's "Fake your Death".
New editor's description: Pay an additional resource cost.
Notes: Prose template exists; Developer-oriented timing control. Has no settings.

Label: Lua Script
Hover text: Runs custom code written by a developer, for effects no other block can do. Used by the Devil Legate's Devilish Charm.
New editor's description: Run arbitrary Lua code.
Notes: For developers only. Needs programming, and errors only show in the developer log.

Label: Macro Execution
Hover text: Runs a typed app command when the ability is used, such as a screen shake or a visual effect on a creature. Used by the ogre juggernaut and Pillar of Holy Fire for visual effects.
New editor's description: Execute a Lua macro script.
Notes: Prose template exists; Developer tool. You need to know the app's command syntax, and it has no rules effect.

Label: Draw Steel Save
Hover text: Has each target make saving throws against its "save ends" conditions and effects; end-of-turn ones simply expire. Can be limited to one chosen condition or set to remove them without rolling. Used by the end-of-turn saving throw and by "remove a condition" abilities.
New editor's description: Force a target to make a resistance roll.
Notes: Prose template exists; The picker currently describes this as "force a resistance roll", which is wrong.

Label: Manipulate Combat Order
Hover text: Changes the turn order. It can start the target's turn now, make the target act next, add the targets to combat on the caster's side, or skip the target's turn. Used by the Tactician, Troubadour and Chronokinetic.
New editor's description: Move creatures in the initiative order.
Notes: Prose template exists; "Begin Turn" and "Skip Turn" only affect the first target.

Label: Opposed Power Roll
Hover text: The user and each target make opposed power rolls with the chosen characteristic and skill. Targets who roll lower count as hit for the rest of the ability, and ties change nothing. Used by Search for Hidden Creatures and the Duelist's Verbal Duel.
New editor's description: Initiate an opposed power roll contest.
Notes: Prose template exists

Label: Roll Dice
Hover text: Rolls a dice formula for each target, e.g. "2d6+3", and keeps the result so later blocks can read it as the cast's roll.
New editor's description: Roll dice and store the result.
Notes: Uses the old pop-up roll window, not the timeline roll card.

Label: Roll on Table
Hover text: Rolls on a table (one built into the block or an existing one) for each target and applies the row that comes up. The result can also be read as a rules effect. Used by the Conduit's and Troubadour's start-of-turn rolls for Piety and Drama.
New editor's description: Roll on a random table.

Label: Skill Check
Hover text: Asks each target to make a pass/fail check against a set difficulty (an attribute, a skill or a flat roll). Targets that fail are recorded so later blocks can apply to them.
New editor's description: Prompt a skill check from a creature.
Notes: Older generic system that uses the old pop-up roll dialog. Draw Steel tests normally use a power roll set up as a test.

Label: Apply Flagged Power Modifiers (Free Strike)
Hover text: Applies any of the striker's power roll bonuses that are marked "apply to free strikes" to a free strike's targets, since free strikes don't go through the normal power roll.
Notes: Codex-internal: added to free strikes automatically and hidden from the normal block picker. Designers shouldn't add it by hand.

Label: Create Lane Object
Hover text: Places a lane along the targeted line that slides creatures toward its far end when they enter it or start their turn there. Creatures already inside slide right away. Built for the Time Raider Helix's Kinetic Lane.
Notes: Made for one monster. Needs a line-shaped area and a suitable lane object.

Label: Loyalty Collar Explosion
Hover text: Blows up the caster's war dog loyalty collar for everyone at the table: explosion effect and sound, the creature hidden in the blast, scorch marks on the floor.
New editor's description: Blow up the caster's loyalty collar.
Notes: Codex-internal, for war dogs only. Visual and sound only: deals no damage and does not kill. Pair it with Destroy or Remove Creature.

Label: Patron
Hover text: Rolls the Acolyte's Patron's Gaze d10 on a special card. If the roll is at or under the current Gaze, it clears the Gaze, grants 2 Zeal and sets off Patron's Spite.
Notes: Codex-internal to the Acolyte's Patron's Gaze; not for general use. The display name is cut short (the full name is "Patron's Gaze Risk Resolve").

Label: Persistence Control
Hover text: At the start of the user's turn, ends persistent abilities whose targets are all dead, then asks which of the rest to keep and shows how much Essence is left after paying for them. Used by the Elementalist's Persistent Magic.
New editor's description: End or extend a persistent ability.
Notes: Prose template exists; Elementalist-specific (Essence wording, start-of-turn resource). Only for triggered abilities.

Label: Recovery Selection
Hover text: Opens the healing choice window: for each target, the player picks how many Recoveries to spend and which effects to end. Extra choices cost the heroic resource, and a setting can make some of them free. Used by the Conduit's Healing Grace and Godsworn's Healing Gift.
New editor's description: Allow target to spend or gain a recovery.
Notes: Prose template exists; Written for Healing Grace's cost rules (each extra target, Recovery or ended effect costs 1).

Label: Routine Control
Hover text: Opens a picker where the Troubadour chooses which routines are active, up to their routine limit. The oldest selection is dropped when they go over.
New editor's description: Control a summon's routine actions.
Notes: Prose template exists; Troubadour-specific. Marked as trigger-only.

Label: Shift Wall Voxel
Hover text: Moves a wall square into one of the squares a pushed creature just left. The user picks the square if there are several. Used by the Wallmaster's "Dead End".
Notes: Codex-internal: works only inside the Wallmaster's specific setup (wall targets, swap to the pushed creature, push, then this block last).

Label: Swing Object
Hover text: Swings a hanging map object like a pendulum, out in a chosen direction and back the other way. Creatures in its path that pass the filter take the effect once per swing (by default 10 damage and possibly prone, but small prone creatures duck under). Used by the Incense Censer.
Notes: Only for abilities a map object gives to creatures. Built for the Incense Censer.

Label: Debug
New editor's description: Debug output for development.

Notes: Saves into another step's record or the card

Hover text: Give the roll an edge or a bane, or set its tier.

Notes: Saves into another step's record or the card

Hover text: The damage from the roll is halved.

Hover text: The target gains surges.
